translations.web: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.
translations.bsb: The sun has one degree of splendor, the moon another, and the stars another; and star differs from star in splendor.
translations.kjv: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
translations.asv: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differeth from another star in glory.
